content.description: We are on a journey to be the digital wardrobe of the metaverse designing a wide range of digital assets so one day your avatar can swagger across the metaverse in style. We begin our journey with the ‘origins’ sneaker art collectables, composed of 2001 NFT sneakers created in 3d using cubes to produce a pixel art form (voxel). Join our discord to be OG and participate in early giveaways! S01E is a collection of FREE TO MINT* sneakers on the Cardano Blockchain.
